cohort: Patients who had at least one live birth after conservative surgery for ovarian endometriosis between January 2009 and December 2016 at a single academic hospital.
finding: Patients with a history of at least one cesarean section after surgery for endometriosis have a higher risk of endometriosis recurrence compared to those who had a vaginal birth.
mod_finding: Cesarean section after surgery for endometriosis is associated with a twofold higher risk of endometriosis recurrence compared to vaginal birth.
